SELECT SM.SALES_NO , SD.SALES_SEQ , SD.PRODUCT_CODE , IM.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME , IM.HS_CODE , SD.QUANTITY , IM.UNIT , SD.UNIT_PRICE , SD.AMOUNT FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND (SM.SALES_NO, SD.SALES_SEQ) IN
(#{d.sales_no}, #{d.sales_seq})

SELECT SM.INVOICE_DATE , D.DIVISION_NAME , C.CUSTOMER_NAME , SM.INVOICE_NO , SM.STATUS , GET_CODE_NAME(SM.STATUS, 'DS', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS STATUS_NAME , GET_CODE_NAME(COALESCE(SM.ARRIVAL_NATION, C.NATION_CODE), 'NA', SM.COMPANY_CODE, 'KOR') AS EXPORT_NATION , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FTA_APPLY_NATION FAN WHERE FAN.NATION_CODE = COALESCE(SM.ARRIVAL_NATION, C.NATION_CODE) AND FAN.EFFECT_DATE <= SM.INVOICE_DATE AND FM.FTA_CODE = FAN.FTA_CODE) AS FTA_CNT FROM ( SELECT SM.COMPANY_CODE , SM.SALES_NO , SM.DIVISION_CODE FROM SALES_MST SM INNER JOIN SALES_DTL SD ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SD.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SD.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = SD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = SD.PRODUCT_CODE WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND SM.EXPORT_FLAG = 'E'
AND SM.INVOICE_DATE BETWEEN #{from_date} AND #{to_date}
AND (SM.PRODUCT_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' OR IM.ITEM_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{product} || '%' )
GROUP BY SM.COMPANY_CODE, SM.SALES_NO, SM.DIVISION_CODE ) SALES INNER JOIN SALES_MST SM ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = SALES.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.SALES_NO = SALES.SALES_NO AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = SALES.DIVISION_CODE LEFT JOIN DIVISION D ON D.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND D.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE INNER JOIN CUSTOMER C ON C.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND C.CUSTOMER_CODE = SM.CUSTOMER_CODE LEFT JOIN FTA_MASTER FM ON SM.COMPANY_CODE = FM.COMPANY_CODE AND SM.TARGET_FTA_CODE = FM.FTA_CODE AND FM.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND FM.FTA_STATUS = '4' WHERE 1=1
AND D.DIVISION_CODE = #{division_code}
AND (C.CUSTOMER_CODE ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' OR C.CUSTOMER_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{customer} || '%' )
ORDER BY SM.INVOICE_DATE, C.CUSTOMER_CODE, D.DIVISION_CODE
